description: Robust vs optimistic Buchi inside a support-EC where nature can route around the accepting state (ISSUE-0009).
provenance: Exact: optimistically nature keeps visiting acc=1 (value 1); robustly nature zeroes the lo=0 edge into 1 forever, never visiting it (value 0). A Storm interval-MDP G F acc query returns the robust value 0; the cooperative/optimistic value is 1.
